candidates.source_title: The Truth Behind China’s Tiny Feet #history
candidates.source_description:
Foot binding was practiced in China for centuries and usually began during childhood. Girls’ feet were tightly wrapped to keep them small, creating a beauty standard that was passed down through families. But the custom wasn’t only about appearance—it was closely tied to social status and a girl’s future prospects.
